title: Mundito
description: Client-side modpack that enhances the vanilla experience without breaking its essence.
body:
![Logo de Mundito](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mochos/Mundito-3/refs/heads/main/marca/Mundito-logo-300.png)

## Enhanced Vanilla Experience

This is a *client-side modpack* crafted to preserve the vanilla Minecraft feel while improving visuals, performance, and quality of life. Perfect for players who want a smoother, clearer, and more comfortable experience without altering core gameplay mechanics.

### Features
- ✅ Compatible with vanilla servers
- 🌟 Subtle visual improvements (lighting, animations, HUD)
- ⚙️ Performance optimizations
- 🎮 QoL tweaks and control enhancements
- 📦 Lightweight and easy to install

> Note: All included mods are client-side only and do not affect gameplay or provide unfair advantages.

Enjoy Minecraft as you know it — just better!
